Vegetation Manhours — Unit-Pricing Pipeline (CatBoost)¶

Imports all logic from veg_pipeline_functions.py; this notebook only sets config, runs the phases, and shows results.

Phase What happens Data used
1–5 Load, clean, engineer, feeder-grouped splits, base matrices all (no fitting)
6 Baseline vs. road challenger (shared params) fit Train+Val, score Test
7 Full-feature splits (road + alley + land cover + 4 area candidates) saved Train-fit transforms
8–9 Dev harness; choose the Urban/Suburban/Rural source column CV on Train+Val
10 Feature pruning per model unit CV
11 Loss/hyperparameter tuning per unit (unit-specific loss families; conditional quantile) CV
12 Tier schemes: hour cuts (searched) and volume quartiles (Train) CV / Train
13 Sample-weighted tuning on under-performing tiers, per scheme CV
14 Multi-quantile models (P10 / P50 / P90) CV
15 CV comparison → champion + primary tier scheme CV
16 Test confirmation + 24-class risk tables + investigate list Test
17 Decisions / artifacts —
18 Holdout breakpoint → 24-class risk tables on holdout Holdout (once)

v3 changes: tier cluster features removed · over/under-sampling replaced by tier sample weights · hour tiers ⇄ volume tiers comparison · per-unit loss families (accessible; inaccessible × suburban / rural / urban) · 24-class accessibility × area × tier risk tables on Test and Holdout.

0. Configuration¶

In [1]:
import os
import sys

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

current_dir = "/mnt/projects/VEG_Contractors/2026unitization/2026unitization/notebooks"
# Get the parent directory of the current file
parent_dir = os.path.abspath(os.path.join(current_dir, os.pardir))
# Construct the path to the 'src/modeling' folder
modeling_dir = os.path.join(parent_dir, "src", "modeling")
# Add 'src/modeling' to the system path
sys.path.insert(0, modeling_dir)
import veg_pipeline_updated as vp  # noqa: E402

READY_FOR_FINAL_HOLDOUT = True         # <-- BREAKPOINT: True only for the one-time final sign-off run
RUN_MODE = os.environ.get("VEG_RUN_MODE", "full")   # "full" | "fast" (smoke test)
SHOW_PLOTS = True                        # figures are also saved to FIG_DIR

INPUT_DIR = os.environ.get("VEG_INPUT_DIR", "../input_data")
OUTPUT_DIR = os.environ.get("VEG_OUTPUT_DIR", "./deployment")
SPLIT_DIR = os.path.join(OUTPUT_DIR, "splits")
FULL_SPLIT_DIR = os.path.join(SPLIT_DIR, "full_features")
FIG_DIR = os.path.join(OUTPUT_DIR, "figures")
FORCE_RESPLIT = False
RUN_EDA = True

# Re-tune switches: True | False | "auto" (auto = re-tune only if features / families / cuts changed)
TUNE_ROAD = False #"auto"
TUNE_REGRESSION = False #"auto"
TUNE_WEIGHTED = False #"auto"

# --- Model units: who gets which loss families -------------------------------------------------
# Accessible: MAE / Huber / Tweedie.  Inaccessible-Suburban: Huber / Tweedie / Q0.55 / Q0.60.
# Inaccessible-Rural (and Urban, unspecified -> same as rural): MAE / Huber / Tweedie, and quantile
# 0.55 / 0.60 ONLY if CV still shows under-prediction after tuning.
MODEL_UNITS = vp.default_model_units()
# TEST confusion grids show Inaccessible-Heavy recall stuck at 7-10% across
# every current candidate (vs 37-46% for Accessible-Heavy), with 66-74% of
# true-Heavy Inaccessible spans landing exactly one tier low. The existing
# 0.55/0.60 quantile ceiling isn't reaching far enough into the tail -
# widen it for Inaccessible units specifically.
MODEL_UNITS = vp.with_conditional_quantiles(MODEL_UNITS, "Inaccessible", (0.55, 0.60, 0.65, 0.70, 0.75))


# --- Tier schemes ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
TIER_SCHEMES_TO_TUNE = ["hours", "volume"]   # weighted tuning is run for each listed scheme
PRIMARY_TIER_SCHEME = "auto"                 # "hours" | "volume" | "auto" (higher 24-class eta2 on CV)
VOLUME_BIN_SCOPE = "global"                  # quartiles over all Train spans, or "segment" (per regime)
USE_RECOMMENDED_HOUR_CUTS = False
HOUR_CUTS_OVERRIDE = {"Accessible": [2.1 , 3.5, 5], "Inaccessible": [3.5 ,5.5, 8]}                    # TODO(veg-team): {"Accessible": [...3], "Inaccessible": [...3]}
CHAMPION_OVERRIDE = "Regression-opt"                     # e.g. "Weighted (volume tiers)"
AREA_COLUMN_OVERRIDE = "area_lcxfm" # e.g. "area_lcxfm"; None = auto-select by CV Selection_Score

# --- 24-class risk table ------------------------------------------------------------------------
vp.RISK_WEIGHTS.update({"width": 0.30, "cv": 0.25, "mae": 0.25, "under_bias": 0.20})
vp.INVESTIGATE_CFG.update({"quantile": 0.75, "min_flags": 2, "risk_threshold": 1.25, "min_n": 30})

BASELINE_PARAMS = {"iterations": 1200, "depth": 6, "learning_rate": 0.05, "l2_leaf_reg": 5.0,
                   "loss_function": "MAE", "eval_metric": "MAE", **vp.CB_FIXED}
DEV_CFG = vp.default_dev_cfg(RUN_MODE)
for d in (OUTPUT_DIR, SPLIT_DIR, FIG_DIR):
    os.makedirs(d, exist_ok=True)
np.random.seed(vp.RANDOM_STATE)


def fig(name):
    return os.path.join(FIG_DIR, name)


print(f"RUN_MODE={RUN_MODE} | READY_FOR_FINAL_HOLDOUT={READY_FOR_FINAL_HOLDOUT}")
vp.show(pd.Series(DEV_CFG), "Dev config")

6. Baseline vs. road challenger (shared parameters)¶

Shared road params re-tune automatically when the road feature list changes (alley / land cover / area added).

In [7]:
X_tune_base = pd.concat([X_red["train"], X_red["valid"]])
y_tune = pd.concat([y_split["train"], y_split["valid"]]).reindex(X_tune_base.index)
baseline_cols = X_tune_base.columns.tolist()
baseline_models = vp.fit_accessibility_pair(X_tune_base, y_tune, flags_all, BASELINE_PARAMS, label="Baseline - ")

road_csv = vp.resolve_road_feature_csv([os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "Accessibility", "bay_geometry_df.csv")])
road_by_bay, road_numeric, road_categorical = vp.load_road_features(road_csv)
bay_key = vp.clean_bay_key(df["bay"])
road_frames = {s: vp.lookup_road_features(X_red[s], bay_key, road_by_bay) for s in vp.SPLIT_NAMES}
road_tf = vp.fit_road_transforms(road_frames["train"], road_numeric, road_categorical)   # Train only
road_frames = {s: vp.apply_road_transforms(f, road_tf) for s, f in road_frames.items()}
road_cols = road_tf["numeric_cols"] + road_categorical

X_road = {s: vp.build_road_matrix(X_red[s], road_frames[s], df, road_cols) for s in vp.SPLIT_NAMES}
road_columns = X_road["train"].columns.tolist()
X_road = {s: X_road[s].reindex(columns=road_columns) for s in vp.SPLIT_NAMES}
X_tune_road = pd.concat([X_road["train"], X_road["valid"]])

ROAD_PARAMS_PATH = os.path.join(OUTPUT_DIR, "road_catboost_params.json")
saved_road = vp.read_json(ROAD_PARAMS_PATH) if os.path.exists(ROAD_PARAMS_PATH) else {}
if TUNE_ROAD is True or (TUNE_ROAD == "auto" and saved_road.get("feature_columns") != road_columns):
    print("Tuning shared road params (feature list changed)...")
    road_params, _ = vp.tune_shared_road_params(
        X_tune_road, y_tune, df.loc[X_tune_road.index, "feeder"], road_categorical, DEV_CFG["n_trials_road"],
        n_folds=DEV_CFG["n_folds"], max_iter_range=(100, 300) if RUN_MODE == "fast" else (500, 1800),
        show_progress=DEV_CFG["show_progress"])
    vp.write_json({"params": road_params, "feature_columns": road_columns,
                   "categorical_features": road_categorical}, ROAD_PARAMS_PATH)
else:
    road_params = saved_road["params"]
    print(f"Loaded shared road params from {ROAD_PARAMS_PATH}")
road_params = {**road_params, "loss_function": "MAE", "eval_metric": "MAE", **vp.CB_FIXED}
road_models = vp.fit_accessibility_pair(X_tune_road, y_tune, flags_all, road_params,
                                        cat_features=road_categorical, label="Road challenger - ")

base_test = vp.predict_accessibility_pair(baseline_models, X_red["test"][baseline_cols], flags_all)
road_test = vp.predict_accessibility_pair(road_models, X_road["test"], flags_all)
vp.show(pd.DataFrame([vp.calculate_metrics("Baseline (no road)", y_split["test"], base_test),
                      vp.calculate_metrics("Road challenger", y_split["test"], road_test)]),
        "Section 6 TEST comparison (shared params)")

8. Development harness¶

All decisions below use feeder-grouped CV on Train+Validation. Early stopping uses a feeder slice of each training fold (unweighted); Test is confirmation only.

In [9]:
ctx = vp.DevContext(FULL_X, FULL_Y, FULL_META, road_categorical, DEV_CFG)
for k, f in enumerate(ctx.folds):
    print(f"Fold {k}: fit={len(f['fit']):,} es={len(f['es']):,} eval={len(f['eval']):,}")

REF_PARAMS = {k: v for k, v in road_params.items() if k not in vp.CB_FIXED and k != "eval_metric"}
REF_PARAMS["iterations"] = DEV_CFG["max_iterations"]
REF_PARAMS["loss_function"] = "RMSE"
if RUN_MODE == "fast":
    REF_PARAMS["learning_rate"] = max(REF_PARAMS.get("learning_rate", 0.05), 0.1)
PROVISIONAL_HOUR_CUTS = {k: list(v) for k, v in vp.PROVISIONAL_TIER_CUTS.items()}

9. Urban / Suburban / Rural source column¶

Each candidate is added alone; the winner (CV selection score = span MAE + feeder WAPE) is kept, the other three dropped. The chosen column also defines the model units.

CHOSEN_AREA_COL, area_cv_table, area_test_table = vp.select_area_column(ctx, REF_PARAMS, PROVISIONAL_HOUR_CUTS) AREA_CLASS_COL = f"area_class__{CHOSEN_AREA_COL}" DROPPED_AREA_COLS = [c for c in vp.AREA_CANDIDATE_COLS if c != CHOSEN_AREA_COL] vp.show(area_cv_table[vp.COMPARE_COLS + ["Selection_Score"]].sort_values("Selection_Score"), "Area candidates - CV") if area_test_table is not None: vp.show(area_test_table[vp.COMPARE_COLS], "Area candidates - TEST (confirmation only)") if area_cv_table.loc[CHOSEN_AREA_COL, "Selection_Score"] > area_cv_table.loc["none", "Selection_Score"]: print(f"NOTE: {CHOSEN_AREA_COL} does not beat 'none' on CV; kept because pricing needs the area dimension.") FEATURES_AFTER_AREA = [c for c in ctx.X_dev.columns if c not in DROPPED_AREA_COLS]

ctx.area_class_col = AREA_CLASS_COL print(f"Chosen area column: {CHOSEN_AREA_COL} | Unmapped share: {(ctx.meta_dev[AREA_CLASS_COL] == 'Unmapped').mean():.1%}") print("\nModel units:") UNITS = vp.resolve_units(ctx, MODEL_UNITS) UNIT_NAMES = [u.name for u in UNITS] vp.show(pd.crosstab(ctx.meta_dev["inaccessible"], ctx.meta_dev[AREA_CLASS_COL]), "Dev spans: inaccessible x area")

In [10]:
# AREA COLUMN =============================================================
# Lighter, faster settings just for area-candidate ranking -- we only need
# the RELATIVE ordering of Selection_Score across candidates, not a
# production-fidelity fit. Uses the same params as REF_PARAMS but caps
# iterations and early stopping much lower.
AREA_SEARCH_PARAMS = {**REF_PARAMS, "iterations": 600}
AREA_SEARCH_CFG_OVERRIDES = {"early_stopping_rounds": 40}
_old_es = ctx.cfg.get("early_stopping_rounds")
ctx.cfg["early_stopping_rounds"] = AREA_SEARCH_CFG_OVERRIDES["early_stopping_rounds"]
ctx.cfg["report_test_for_experiments"] = False

_, area_cv_table, area_test_table = vp.select_area_column(ctx, AREA_SEARCH_PARAMS, PROVISIONAL_HOUR_CUTS)

ctx.cfg["early_stopping_rounds"] = _old_es   # restore for everything downstream

CHOSEN_AREA_COL, AUTO_CHOSEN_AREA_COL, AREA_OVERRIDE_USED = vp.resolve_area_column(
    area_cv_table, override=AREA_COLUMN_OVERRIDE)
AREA_CLASS_COL = f"area_class__{CHOSEN_AREA_COL}"
DROPPED_AREA_COLS = [c for c in vp.AREA_CANDIDATE_COLS if c != CHOSEN_AREA_COL]

vp.show(area_cv_table[vp.COMPARE_COLS + ["Selection_Score"]].sort_values("Selection_Score"), "Area candidates - CV")
if AREA_OVERRIDE_USED:
    print(f"AREA_COLUMN_OVERRIDE active: using {CHOSEN_AREA_COL!r} "
          f"(CV auto-selection would have chosen {AUTO_CHOSEN_AREA_COL!r}).")
if area_cv_table.loc[CHOSEN_AREA_COL, "Selection_Score"] > area_cv_table.loc["none", "Selection_Score"]:
    print(f"NOTE: {CHOSEN_AREA_COL} does not beat 'none' on CV; kept because pricing needs the area dimension.")
FEATURES_AFTER_AREA = [c for c in ctx.X_dev.columns if c not in DROPPED_AREA_COLS]

ctx.area_class_col = AREA_CLASS_COL
print(f"Chosen area column: {CHOSEN_AREA_COL} | Unmapped share: {(ctx.meta_dev[AREA_CLASS_COL] == 'Unmapped').mean():.1%}")
print("\nModel units:")
UNITS = vp.resolve_units(ctx, MODEL_UNITS)
UNIT_NAMES = [u.name for u in UNITS]
vp.show(pd.crosstab(ctx.meta_dev["inaccessible"], ctx.meta_dev[AREA_CLASS_COL]), "Dev spans: inaccessible x area")

# Get a real Test-confirmed number for the WINNER only (1 candidate, not 4).
if CHOSEN_AREA_COL != "none":
    winner_feats = [c for c in ctx.X_dev.columns if c not in DROPPED_AREA_COLS]
    winner_spec = {}
    for u in UNITS:
        cv_result = vp.cv_unit(ctx, u, winner_feats, REF_PARAMS)
        winner_spec[u.name] = {
            "features": winner_feats,
            "params": REF_PARAMS,
            "iterations": vp.iterations_for_refit(ctx, cv_result["best_iteration"], ("train", "valid")),
        }
    winner_pred, _, _ = vp.refit_and_predict(ctx, winner_spec, UNITS)
    area_test_table = pd.DataFrame(
        [vp.evaluate_combined(CHOSEN_AREA_COL, ctx.full_y["test"], winner_pred, ctx.full_meta["test"], PROVISIONAL_HOUR_CUTS)]
    ).set_index("Model")
    vp.show(area_test_table[vp.COMPARE_COLS], "Area candidate (winner) - TEST (confirmation only)")

10. Feature pruning per model unit¶

Group ablations (incl. alley), near-duplicates and out-of-fold importance drops; the 1-SE rule keeps the smallest good set. Only the chosen area column is protected (the cluster tier features no longer exist).

11. Loss + hyperparameter tuning per unit¶

Each unit searches only its permitted loss families. Units with conditional_quantiles (inaccessible rural/urban) first tune MAE / Huber / Tweedie; quantile 0.55 / 0.60 are tried only if the tuned CV predictions still under-predict (sum ratio < 1 − underpred_ratio_tol or under-prediction rate > underpred_rate_tol), and adopted only if they improve the CV objective.

In [12]:
REG_PATH = os.path.join(OUTPUT_DIR, "unit_regression_params.json")
expected_reg = {u.name: {"features": SELECTED_FEATURES[u.name], "families": u.families,
                         "train_scope": u.train_scope} for u in UNITS}
REG_SPEC = {}
if TUNE_REGRESSION is True or (TUNE_REGRESSION == "auto" and not vp.spec_is_current(REG_PATH, expected_reg)):
    for u in UNITS:
        feats = SELECTED_FEATURES[u.name]
        ref = PRUNE_REF[u.name]
        objective_fn = vp.make_objective_fn(ctx, {"mae": ref["mae"], "feeder_wape": ref["feeder_wape"]})
        print(f"\nTuning {u.name} over {u.families} ({DEV_CFG['n_trials_reg']} trials)")
        study = vp.run_study(f"reg_{u.name}", vp.make_study_objective(ctx, u, feats, u.families, objective_fn),
                             DEV_CFG["n_trials_reg"], vp.default_seed_params(REF_PARAMS, u.families[0]),
                             show_progress=DEV_CFG["show_progress"])
        spec = {**expected_reg[u.name], "trial_params": study.best_trial.params, "loss_override": None,
                "best_family": study.best_trial.params["loss_family"], "families_used": list(u.families),
                "cv_objective": study.best_value, "quantile_check": None}
        study.trials_dataframe().to_csv(os.path.join(OUTPUT_DIR, f"unit_regression_trials_{u.name}.csv"), index=False)

        if u.conditional_quantiles:
            params = vp.params_from_trial(spec["trial_params"], u.families, DEV_CFG["max_iterations"])
            base = vp.cv_unit(ctx, u, feats, params)
            check = {"sum_ratio": base["sum_ratio"], "under_rate": base["under_rate"],
                     "underpredicting": vp.underprediction_flag(base, DEV_CFG), "tried": {}}
            if check["underpredicting"]:
                for alpha in u.conditional_quantiles:
                    q_params = {**params, "loss_function": vp.loss_label_to_catboost(vp.quantile_label(alpha))}
                    rq = vp.cv_unit(ctx, u, feats, q_params)
                    check["tried"][alpha] = {"objective": objective_fn(rq["oof"].index, rq["oof"].to_numpy()),
                                             "sum_ratio": rq["sum_ratio"], "under_rate": rq["under_rate"]}
                best_alpha = min(check["tried"], key=lambda a: check["tried"][a]["objective"])
                if check["tried"][best_alpha]["objective"] < spec["cv_objective"]:
                    label = vp.quantile_label(best_alpha)
                    spec.update(loss_override=vp.loss_label_to_catboost(label), best_family=label,
                                families_used=list(u.families) + [label],
                                cv_objective=check["tried"][best_alpha]["objective"])
            spec["quantile_check"] = check
            print(f"  quantile check: {check}")
        REG_SPEC[u.name] = spec
    vp.write_json(REG_SPEC, REG_PATH)
else:
    REG_SPEC = vp.read_json(REG_PATH)
    print(f"Loaded unit regression specs from {REG_PATH}")

reg_cv = {}
for u in UNITS:
    s = REG_SPEC[u.name]
    s["params"] = vp.params_from_trial(s["trial_params"], s["families"], DEV_CFG["max_iterations"], s["loss_override"])
    reg_cv[u.name] = vp.cv_unit(ctx, u, s["features"], s["params"])
    s["cv_best_iteration"] = reg_cv[u.name]["best_iteration"]
REG_OOF = vp.combine_predictions({n: r["oof"] for n, r in reg_cv.items()}, ctx.X_dev.index)
vp.show(pd.DataFrame({n: {"loss": REG_SPEC[n]["params"]["loss_function"], "cv_mae": reg_cv[n]["mae"],
                          "pruned_ref_mae": PRUNE_REF[n]["mae"], "feeder_wape": reg_cv[n]["feeder_wape"],
                          "sum_ratio": reg_cv[n]["sum_ratio"], "under_rate": reg_cv[n]["under_rate"],
                          "quantile_check": (REG_SPEC[n]["quantile_check"] or {}).get("underpredicting")}
                      for n in UNIT_NAMES}).T, "Tuned unit models (CV)")

12. Tier schemes: hours ⇄ volume¶

  • Hours: 3 cuts per accessibility regime searched on CV OOF predictions (midpoints between recorded values; ≥10% of spans per tier; ranked by weighted kappa + η²). At bid time a span is priced in its predicted hour tier.
  • Volume: Train quartiles of bay_total_intrusion_volume_(cubic_ft) — known before work, so no prediction is needed to tier.

13. Sample-weighted tuning (replaces over/under-sampling)¶

Tier weights come from how badly the tuned regression models handle each tier on CV: hours → 1 − recall of the true hour tier; volume → relative MAE + relative under-prediction of the volume tier. Row weight = 1 + weight_strength × badness (normalized to mean 1). weight_strength is searched from 0, and the search is seeded with the unweighted regression winner, so CV can reject weighting (it hurt in an earlier iteration). Objective (lower = better, each term relative to the regression winner): hours = MAE + feeder WAPE + hour-tier loss + class WAPE; volume = MAE + feeder WAPE + class WAPE.

In [14]:
WEIGHTINGS = {n: vp.TierWeighting.from_oof(SCHEMES[n], ctx.X_dev, ctx.y_dev, REG_OOF, ctx.meta_dev)
              for n in TIER_SCHEMES_TO_TUNE}
for n, tw in WEIGHTINGS.items():
    vp.show(pd.DataFrame(tw.badness, index=vp.TIER_LABELS), f"{n} tiers - badness (0 = fine, 1 = worst tier)")

WEIGHTED_PATH = os.path.join(OUTPUT_DIR, "unit_weighted_params.json")
expected_w = {f"{n}|{u.name}": {"features": REG_SPEC[u.name]["features"],
                                "families": REG_SPEC[u.name]["families_used"],
                                "cuts": SCHEMES[n].to_dict()["cuts"], "badness": WEIGHTINGS[n].badness}
              for n in TIER_SCHEMES_TO_TUNE for u in UNITS}
WEIGHTED_SPEC = {}
if TUNE_WEIGHTED is True or (TUNE_WEIGHTED == "auto" and not vp.spec_is_current(WEIGHTED_PATH, expected_w)):
    for n in TIER_SCHEMES_TO_TUNE:
        for u in UNITS:
            key = f"{n}|{u.name}"
            idx = reg_cv[u.name]["oof"].index
            ref_terms = vp.raw_objective_terms(ctx, idx, reg_cv[u.name]["oof"].to_numpy(), SCHEMES[n])
            objective_fn = vp.make_objective_fn(ctx, ref_terms, SCHEMES[n])
            fams = REG_SPEC[u.name]["families_used"]
            seed = {**REG_SPEC[u.name]["trial_params"], "loss_family": REG_SPEC[u.name]["best_family"],
                    "weight_strength": 0.0}
            print(f"\nWeighted tuning [{n}] {u.name} ({DEV_CFG['n_trials_weighted']} trials)")
            study = vp.run_study(f"w_{key}", vp.make_study_objective(ctx, u, REG_SPEC[u.name]["features"], fams,
                                                                     objective_fn, WEIGHTINGS[n]),
                                 DEV_CFG["n_trials_weighted"], seed, show_progress=DEV_CFG["show_progress"])
            WEIGHTED_SPEC[key] = {**expected_w[key], "trial_params": study.best_trial.params,
                                  "cv_objective": study.best_value}
    vp.write_json(WEIGHTED_SPEC, WEIGHTED_PATH)
else:
    WEIGHTED_SPEC = vp.read_json(WEIGHTED_PATH)
    print(f"Loaded weighted specs from {WEIGHTED_PATH}")

weighted_cv, WEIGHTED_OOF, w_rows = {}, {}, []
for n in TIER_SCHEMES_TO_TUNE:
    tw = WEIGHTINGS[n]
    preds = {}
    for u in UNITS:
        key = f"{n}|{u.name}"
        s = WEIGHTED_SPEC[key]
        s["params"] = vp.params_from_trial(s["trial_params"], s["families"], DEV_CFG["max_iterations"])
        s["strength"] = float(s["trial_params"].get("weight_strength", 0.0))
        wfn = None if s["strength"] == 0 else (
            lambda idx, st=s["strength"]: tw.row_weights(ctx.X_dev.loc[idx], ctx.y_dev.loc[idx], ctx.meta_dev.loc[idx], st))
        r = vp.cv_unit(ctx, u, s["features"], s["params"], weight_fn=wfn)
        s["cv_best_iteration"] = r["best_iteration"]
        weighted_cv[key], preds[u.name] = r, r["oof"]
        w_rows.append({"Scheme": n, "Unit": u.name, "loss": s["params"]["loss_function"],
                       "weight_strength": s["strength"], "cv_mae": r["mae"],
                       "reg_cv_mae": reg_cv[u.name]["mae"], "sum_ratio": r["sum_ratio"]})
    WEIGHTED_OOF[n] = vp.combine_predictions(preds, ctx.X_dev.index)
vp.show(pd.DataFrame(w_rows), "Weighted models (CV) - weight_strength 0 means CV rejected weighting")
for n in TIER_SCHEMES_TO_TUNE:
    for u in UNITS:
        st = WEIGHTED_SPEC[f"{n}|{u.name}"]["strength"]
        if st > 0:
            vp.show(WEIGHTINGS[n].weight_table(st), f"[{n}] {u.name} effective tier weights (before mean-normalizing)", 3)

14. Multi-quantile models (P10 / P50 / P90)¶

One per unit, using the unit's tuned tree parameters. Supplies the P10/P50/P90 and prediction width of the risk tables. Span quantiles do not add up to feeder quantiles.

OOF_SCALE = {n: float(ctx.y_dev.loc[reg_cv[n]["oof"].index].sum() / reg_cv[n]["oof"].sum()) for n in UNIT_NAMES}
cv_candidates = {"Regression-opt": REG_OOF,
                 "Regression-opt + OOF scale": vp.scale_by_unit(REG_OOF, ctx.meta_dev, OOF_SCALE, UNITS, AREA_CLASS_COL)}
cv_candidates.update({f"Weighted ({n} tiers)": WEIGHTED_OOF[n] for n in TIER_SCHEMES_TO_TUNE})

# TEST confusion grids showed Inaccessible-Heavy recall stuck at 7-10% across
# every candidate (vs 37-46% for Accessible-Heavy), with 66-74% of true-Heavy
# Inaccessible spans landing exactly one tier low. This candidate targets that
# failure mode directly: an additive correction fit on OOF residuals, grouped
# by (accessibility, PREDICTED hour-tier) - so it corrects specifically the
# spans the model is already routing into the wrong (one-tier-low) bucket.
TIER_BIAS_CALIBRATION = vp.fit_tier_conditional_bias(
    REG_OOF, ctx.y_dev, ctx.meta_dev, SCHEMES["hours"], ctx.X_dev,
    min_rows=60, shrinkage_rows=150, max_abs_adjustment=2.0)
vp.show(TIER_BIAS_CALIBRATION.sort_values("Adjustment", ascending=False),
        "OOF tier-conditional bias correction (accessibility x predicted hour-tier)")
cv_candidates["Regression-opt + tier bias correction"] = vp.apply_tier_conditional_bias(
    REG_OOF, ctx.meta_dev, TIER_BIAS_CALIBRATION, SCHEMES["hours"], ctx.X_dev)

cv_compare = pd.DataFrame([vp.evaluate_combined(k, ctx.y_dev, p, ctx.meta_dev, HOUR_CUTS)
                           for k, p in cv_candidates.items()]).set_index("Model")
cv_compare["Selection_Score"] = cv_compare.apply(
    lambda r: vp.selection_score(r, cv_compare.loc["Regression-opt"], DEV_CFG), axis=1)
vp.show(cv_compare[vp.COMPARE_COLS + ["Selection_Score"]], "CV comparison (selection)")
for k, p in cv_candidates.items():
    vp.show(vp.evaluate_units(ctx.y_dev, p, ctx.meta_dev, UNITS, AREA_CLASS_COL), f"CV by unit - {k}")
    vp.show(vp.heavy_tier_recall_table(ctx.y_dev, p, ctx.meta_dev, SCHEMES["hours"], ctx.X_dev),
            f"CV top-tier recall by accessibility - {k}")

# The OOF-scale and tier-bias-correction variants are both fit on these same
# OOF rows, so neither is eligible for automatic CHAMPION selection on CV.
CHAMPION = CHAMPION_OVERRIDE or cv_compare.drop(
    index=["Regression-opt + OOF scale", "Regression-opt + tier bias correction"]
)["Selection_Score"].idxmin()
print(f"CHAMPION (by CV): {CHAMPION}")

# Primary tier scheme from the CV 24-class tables of the champion
cv_champ = cv_candidates[CHAMPION]
cv_risk, cv_class_labels = {}, {}
for n, scheme in SCHEMES.items():
    labels = scheme.bid_labels(ctx.X_dev, cv_champ, ctx.meta_dev)
    cv_risk[n] = vp.class_risk_table(ctx.y_dev, cv_champ, MQ_OOF[0.1], MQ_OOF[0.5], MQ_OOF[0.9],
                                     ctx.meta_dev, AREA_CLASS_COL, labels, n_boot=500)
    cv_class_labels[n] = vp.class_keys(ctx.meta_dev, AREA_CLASS_COL, labels)
in_area = ctx.meta_dev[AREA_CLASS_COL].isin(vp.AREA_CLASSES).to_numpy()
cv_scheme_summary = vp.scheme_summary(cv_risk, ctx.y_dev[in_area], {n: v[in_area] for n, v in cv_class_labels.items()})
vp.show(cv_scheme_summary, "CV scheme comparison (champion predictions)")
PRIMARY = (PRIMARY_TIER_SCHEME if PRIMARY_TIER_SCHEME != "auto"
           else cv_scheme_summary.sort_values(["Eta2_24class", "Weighted_Risk"], ascending=[False, True]).index[0])

16. Test confirmation + 24-class risk tables¶

Models are refit on Train+Validation. Class = accessibility × area × bid-time tier (hour scheme: tier of the prediction; volume scheme: tier of the LiDAR volume). Classes flagged Investigate are high-variability: top-quartile on at least min_flags of {prediction width, CV of hours, MAE}, or risk score ≥ risk_threshold (with N ≥ min_n).

In [17]:
def unit_spec(kind, fit_splits=("train", "valid")):
    spec = {}
    for u in UNITS:
        if kind in ("Regression-opt", "Regression-opt + OOF scale", "Regression-opt + tier bias correction"):
            s = REG_SPEC[u.name]
            spec[u.name] = {"features": s["features"], "params": s["params"],
                            "iterations": vp.iterations_for_refit(ctx, s["cv_best_iteration"], fit_splits)}
        elif kind == "Multi-quantile":
            s = REG_SPEC[u.name]
            spec[u.name] = {"features": s["features"], "params": s["mq_params"], "quantile_alphas": MQ_ALPHAS,
                            "iterations": vp.iterations_for_refit(ctx, s["mq_cv_best_iteration"], fit_splits)}
        else:
            n = kind.split("(")[1].split()[0]           # "Weighted (hours tiers)" -> "hours"
            s = WEIGHTED_SPEC[f"{n}|{u.name}"]
            spec[u.name] = {"features": s["features"], "params": s["params"],
                            "weighting": (WEIGHTINGS[n], s["strength"]) if s["strength"] > 0 else None,
                            "iterations": vp.iterations_for_refit(ctx, s["cv_best_iteration"], fit_splits)}
    return spec

def risk_tables(split_label, X, y, meta, point, qframe):
    tables, labels = {}, {}
    for n, scheme in SCHEMES.items():
        lab = scheme.bid_labels(X, point, meta)
        tables[n] = vp.class_risk_table(y, point, qframe[0.1], qframe[0.5], qframe[0.9], meta, AREA_CLASS_COL, lab)
        labels[n] = vp.class_keys(meta, AREA_CLASS_COL, lab)
        tag = " (PRIMARY)" if n == PRIMARY else ""
        vp.show(tables[n][vp.RISK_TABLE_COLS + ["Flagged_On"]],
                f"{split_label} - 24-class risk table, {n} tiers{tag} "
                f"[unmapped spans excluded: {tables[n].attrs['unmapped_spans']}]", 2, max_rows=30)
        vp.plot_risk_heatmap(tables[n], f"{split_label} {n}", "Risk_Score",
                             fig(f"{split_label.lower()}_{n}_risk_heatmap.png"), SHOW_PLOTS)
    in_area = meta[AREA_CLASS_COL].isin(vp.AREA_CLASSES).to_numpy()
    summary = vp.scheme_summary(tables, np.asarray(y)[in_area], {n: v[in_area] for n, v in labels.items()})
    vp.show(summary, f"{split_label} - hour vs volume tier scheme")
    investigate = pd.concat({n: t[t["Investigate"]].sort_values("Risk_Score", ascending=False)
                             [["N", "Mean_Hours", "CV", "Pred_Width", "MAE", "Bias", "Risk_Score", "Flagged_On"]]
                             for n, t in tables.items()}, names=["Scheme"])
    vp.show(investigate, f"{split_label} - classes to investigate (high variability)", 2)
    return tables, summary, investigate

FLAGGED_DEVICES = {
    "protective_device": ["23407", "271291X1", "10436", "257083X1", "443229"],
    "major_protective_device": ["J3970", "416605", "388878", "564047"],
}

def inspect_device_spans(device_col, device_ids, meta, actual, pred_dict, X):
    """
    One row per span for the flagged device IDs, with actual/predicted from
    every candidate model side-by-side, plus the raw features most likely
    to explain a large miss (contact volume, span length, issue flags).
    """
    mask = meta[device_col].isin(device_ids)
    idx = meta.index[mask.to_numpy()]

    out = meta.loc[idx, [device_col, "feeder", "inaccessible", AREA_CLASS_COL]].copy()
    out["actual"] = actual.loc[idx]
    for name, p in pred_dict.items():
        out[f"pred_{name}"] = p.loc[idx]
        out[f"abs_err_{name}"] = (p.loc[idx] - actual.loc[idx]).abs()

    # Pull a few raw diagnostic features if present (adjust names to match your feature set)
    diag_cols = [c for c in [
        "heavy_contact_vol", "moderate_contact_vol", "side_intrusion_vol",
        "bay_total_intrusion_volume_(cubic_ft)", "span_length_ft",
        "impactful_issues", "veg_tier",
    ] if c in X.columns]
    for c in diag_cols:
        out[c] = X.loc[idx, c]

    return out.sort_values(f"abs_err_{list(pred_dict)[0]}", ascending=False)


device_span_detail = inspect_device_spans(
    "protective_device", FLAGGED_DEVICES["protective_device"], test_meta, y_test, test_preds, X_test)
vp.show(device_span_detail, "TEST - span-level detail for flagged protective_device groups", 3, max_rows=60)

major_device_span_detail = inspect_device_spans(
    "major_protective_device", FLAGGED_DEVICES["major_protective_device"], test_meta, y_test, test_preds, X_test)
vp.show(major_device_span_detail, "TEST - span-level detail for flagged major_protective_device groups", 3, max_rows=60)

18. FINAL HOLDOUT — breakpoint¶

With READY_FOR_FINAL_HOLDOUT = False this cell stops Run All on purpose. When True, the frozen champion and the multi-quantile models are refit on Train + Validation + Test and holdout is scored once; every run is logged. Do not change the champion, tiers, or weights based on these results.

In [23]:
if not READY_FOR_FINAL_HOLDOUT:
    raise vp.HoldoutBreakpoint("READY_FOR_FINAL_HOLDOUT is False - development phase complete; holdout untouched.")

FINAL_FIT = ("train", "valid", "test")
h_meta, y_hold, X_hold = FULL_META["holdout"], FULL_Y["holdout"], FULL_X["holdout"]
print("=" * 72 + f"\nHOLDOUT IS BEING SCORED - champion: {CHAMPION}\n" + "=" * 72)


hold_pred, final_models, _ = vp.refit_and_predict(ctx, unit_spec(CHAMPION, FINAL_FIT), UNITS, FINAL_FIT, "holdout")
if CHAMPION == "Regression-opt + OOF scale":
    hold_pred = vp.scale_by_unit(hold_pred, h_meta, OOF_SCALE, UNITS, AREA_CLASS_COL)
_, final_mq, HOLD_Q = vp.refit_and_predict(ctx, unit_spec("Multi-quantile", FINAL_FIT), UNITS, FINAL_FIT, "holdout")

h_meta = vp.attach_device_columns(h_meta, DEVICE_MAP)

for device_col in vp.PROTECTIVE_DEVICE_COLS:
    vp.protective_device_scatter(
        {CHAMPION: hold_pred}, y_hold, h_meta, device_col,
        "HOLDOUT", fig(f"18_holdout_{device_col}_scatter.png"), SHOW_PLOTS)

hold_row = vp.evaluate_combined(f"{CHAMPION} (HOLDOUT)", y_hold, hold_pred, h_meta, HOUR_CUTS)
vp.show(pd.DataFrame([hold_row]).set_index("Model")[vp.COMPARE_COLS].T, "HOLDOUT")
vp.show(vp.evaluate_units(y_hold, hold_pred, h_meta, UNITS, AREA_CLASS_COL), "HOLDOUT by unit")
vp.show(vp.quantile_calibration(y_hold, HOLD_Q, h_meta, UNITS, AREA_CLASS_COL), "HOLDOUT quantile calibration")
vp.confusion_grid({CHAMPION: hold_pred}, y_hold, h_meta, HOUR_CUTS, "HOLDOUT",
                  fig("18_holdout_hour_tier_confusion.png"), SHOW_PLOTS)
hold_feeders = vp.feeder_scatter({CHAMPION: hold_pred}, y_hold, h_meta, "HOLDOUT",
                                 fig("18_holdout_feeder_scatter.png"), SHOW_PLOTS)[CHAMPION]
if "impactful_issues" in h_meta.columns:
    vp.show(vp.issue_table(y_hold, hold_pred, h_meta["impactful_issues"]), "HOLDOUT errors by impactful issue", 3)

HOLD_RISK, HOLD_SCHEME_SUMMARY, HOLD_INVESTIGATE = risk_tables("HOLDOUT", X_hold, y_hold, h_meta, hold_pred, HOLD_Q)

# Classes flagged on both Test and Holdout are the most reliable investigation targets.
for n in SCHEMES:
    both = TEST_RISK[n]["Investigate"] & HOLD_RISK[n]["Investigate"]
    vp.show(pd.DataFrame({"Test_Risk": TEST_RISK[n]["Risk_Score"], "Holdout_Risk": HOLD_RISK[n]["Risk_Score"],
                          "Test_N": TEST_RISK[n]["N"], "Holdout_N": HOLD_RISK[n]["N"]})[both],
            f"{n} tiers - flagged on BOTH Test and Holdout", 2)

out = h_meta.copy()
out["actual_manhours"], out["predicted_manhours"] = y_hold, hold_pred
for a in MQ_ALPHAS:
    out[f"q{int(round(a * 100))}"] = HOLD_Q[a]
for n, scheme in SCHEMES.items():
    out[f"bid_tier_{n}"] = scheme.bid_labels(X_hold, hold_pred, h_meta)
out.to_csv(os.path.join(OUTPUT_DIR, "holdout_predictions.csv"))
hold_feeders.to_csv(os.path.join(OUTPUT_DIR, "holdout_feeder_totals.csv"))
for n, t in HOLD_RISK.items():
    t.to_csv(os.path.join(OUTPUT_DIR, f"holdout_risk_table_{n}.csv"))
HOLD_INVESTIGATE.to_csv(os.path.join(OUTPUT_DIR, "holdout_investigate_classes.csv"))
for name in final_models:
    final_models[name].save_model(os.path.join(OUTPUT_DIR, f"final_{name.lower()}.cbm"))
    final_mq[name].save_model(os.path.join(OUTPUT_DIR, f"final_multiquantile_{name.lower()}.cbm"))
vp.append_holdout_log(os.path.join(OUTPUT_DIR, "holdout_run_log.jsonl"), {
    "timestamp": pd.Timestamp.now().isoformat(), "model": f"CatBoost {CHAMPION}", "fit_splits": FINAL_FIT,
    "metrics": hold_row, "scheme_summary": HOLD_SCHEME_SUMMARY.to_dict(orient="index"),
    "investigate": {n: t.index[t["Investigate"]].tolist() for n, t in HOLD_RISK.items()}})
print("Holdout predictions, risk tables, final models, and run log saved.")

vp.confusion_grid_by_area(
    {CHAMPION: hold_pred}, y_hold, h_meta, HOUR_CUTS, AREA_CLASS_COL,

    area_classes=vp.AREA_CLASSES,
